# Two edits in one file: the 2026-01-06 AMZN price moves onto 2026-01-07, and
# the 2026-01-07 AMZN price moves on to 2026-01-08.
#
# The first block is the one moving onto a day that is still taken when it is
# read; the second is the one that frees that day. So a file applied in order
# would refuse the first.
#
# What this fixture produces, on a book holding
# prices_of_a_currency_and_a_stock.txt and another_amzn_price_a_day_later.txt:
# guid 4a1a4c0c7328491fbde9f8099ba280c8 at 2026-01-07 21:00 UTC and guid
# 5b2b5d1d8439402a96c7f910acb391d9 at 2026-01-08 21:00 UTC, both updated.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_price_is_changed_through_its_guid.py.
price
	guid: "4a1a4c0c7328491fbde9f8099ba280c8"
	time: "2026-01-07 21:00:00 +0000"

price
	guid: "5b2b5d1d8439402a96c7f910acb391d9"
	time: "2026-01-08 21:00:00 +0000"
